description: Answer "does HelloBooks work with <bank/app/service>?" deterministically. Pass a `name` (e.g. "Stripe", "HDFC Bank", "Shopify", "QuickBooks"). Returns a `supported` yes/no with the matched integration and its rollout `status` (live/beta/coming-soon), or the closest catalog `suggestions` when there is no direct match. Prefer this over free-text search when the user names a specific provider.

name.description: The bank, payment provider, app, or service to check, e.g. "Stripe", "HDFC Bank", "Shopify", "QuickBooks".

name: check_integration
